dialogue.origin: (よろしくお願いいたします)
dialogue.content: (Thank you for coming today.)

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。スタンバイしてます
dialogue.content: Thank you. I’m ready.

dialogue.origin: (はじめますね！)
dialogue.content: (Let’s get started!)

dialogue.origin: はい！
dialogue.content: Yes!

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。
dialogue.content: Hello, I’m the counselor.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: How can I help you today?

dialogue.origin: とうとう、家賃が払えなくなりました
dialogue.content: I've finally reached the point where I can't pay my rent.

dialogue.origin: 落ち込んでいます
dialogue.content: I’m feeling really down.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね…
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: それはこの先心配になってしまいますよね…
dialogue.content: That must make you very worried about the future...

dialogue.origin: ええ。この先が見えません
dialogue.content: Yes. I can't see a way forward.

dialogue.origin: とうとうというのは…いつ頃からお困りだったのですか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned "finally"... how long have you been in this difficult situation?

dialogue.origin: 1カ月くらいです
dialogue.content: For about a month.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。。それは…辛い…。どんなことがありましたか？
dialogue.content: I see... That must be so difficult... What has been happening?

dialogue.origin: コロナの影響で、仕事が少なくなり、給料がかなり減りました
dialogue.content: Due to COVID, my work has decreased, and my salary has dropped significantly.

dialogue.origin: 非正規雇用なので
dialogue.content: I'm not a permanent employee.

dialogue.origin: ええ…それは不安になりますよね…。
dialogue.content: Yes... That must be very unsettling...

dialogue.origin: どんなお仕事をされてらっしゃるんですか？
dialogue.content: What kind of work do you do?

dialogue.origin: 飲食店の店員です
dialogue.content: I work at a restaurant.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see, I understand.

dialogue.origin: 急に来た状況で気持ちが対応しきれないですよね。。
dialogue.content: It must be hard to mentally cope with such a sudden change in circumstances.

dialogue.origin: お客さんも減ったりとかしてるんでしょうか？どんな状況ですか？
dialogue.content: Have customers decreased? What's the situation like?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。コロナでお客さんがすごく、減ってしまって。徐々に戻ってきてはいるんですけど、
dialogue.content: That's right. The number of customers dropped drastically because of COVID. They're gradually coming back, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: Yes,

dialogue.origin: (お話しくださいね)
dialogue.content: (Please continue.)

dialogue.origin: でも、コロナ前の半分くらいだと思います
dialogue.content: ...but I'd say it's still only about half of what it was before COVID.

dialogue.origin: ええ…それは…
dialogue.content: Yes... that's...

dialogue.origin: だから、もろに給料に響いてしまって
dialogue.content: So it's directly affecting my salary.

dialogue.origin: ええ…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 心がついていけず混乱しますよね。。
dialogue.content: It's understandable to feel confused and overwhelmed by it all.

dialogue.origin: ええ。他の仕事探して働いたんですけど、
dialogue.content: Yes. I looked for another job and started working, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今度は、体調が悪くなってしまって
dialogue.content: ...and then my health started to suffer.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですか…
dialogue.content: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that...

dialogue.origin: 結局辞めてしまったんです
dialogue.content: In the end, I had to quit.

dialogue.origin: 掛け持ちされていたということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So you were working two jobs?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: That’s right.

dialogue.origin: 夜のレジ
dialogue.content: A night cashier job.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですか…お辛い経験をされていたのですね。。
dialogue.content: I see... That must have been a very difficult experience for you.

dialogue.origin: 今はどんな働き方をされているんですか？
dialogue.content: What is your current work situation?

dialogue.origin: ええ。なんとか生活費を稼ごうと。今は、週1回だけ2時間くらいそのお世話になってる飲食店で働いてます
dialogue.content: Yes. I was just trying to earn enough to cover living expenses. Right now, I'm only working at that restaurant once a week for about two hours.

dialogue.origin: でも、かなり生活苦しい
dialogue.content: But it's a real struggle financially.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そうですよね…
dialogue.content: Yes, I can imagine...

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいのか
dialogue.content: I don’t know what to do.

dialogue.origin: 未来が見えずもやもやしますよね。一緒に考えていきましょうね。
dialogue.content: It's frustrating when you can't see the future clearly. Let's think about this together.

dialogue.origin: もう少しお話し聞いてもいいですか？
dialogue.content: May I ask a bit more?

dialogue.origin: はい。お願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご家族は何と言っているんですか？
dialogue.content: What does your family say about this?

dialogue.origin: 今、独身で1人暮らしなので…両親は地方にいて、実家に戻ることもできるんですけど、あまり仲がよくなくて
dialogue.content: I’m single and living alone right now... My parents live in the countryside, and I could go back home, but we’re not on very good terms.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうだったんですか…それは帰りたくないですよね…
dialogue.content: I see... You wouldn't want to go back, then...

dialogue.origin: 今は、ご体調はいかがですか？
dialogue.content: How is your health now?

dialogue.origin: ええ。前よりは体調ましになりました
dialogue.content: Yes. I'm feeling better than before.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、それは安心しました。ご実家が仲良くないというのはどんな感じなんですか？
dialogue.content: I see, I'm relieved to hear that. In what way do you not get along with your family?

dialogue.origin: 妹がいるんですけど、よく出来る子で、正直ずっと比べられてきました。頭も良いし
dialogue.content: I have a younger sister, and she's very capable. To be honest, I've been compared to her my whole life. She's smart, too.

dialogue.origin: 居心地が悪かったです
dialogue.content: I felt uncomfortable there.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですか…それは実家にいるのも嫌になりますよね
dialogue.content: I see... That would certainly make you not want to be at home.

dialogue.origin: いつ頃出てこられたんですか？
dialogue.content: When did you move out?

dialogue.origin: はい。両親と妹が実家で暮らしているので
dialogue.content: Yes. My parents and sister live at the family home.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 社会人になってすぐです
dialogue.content: Right after I started working.

dialogue.origin: 高卒で関東へ引っ越しました
dialogue.content: I moved to the Kanto region right after graduating high school.

dialogue.origin: そうですか…それは沢山頑張ってこられたのですね。
dialogue.content: I see... You've been working so hard for so long.

dialogue.origin: 出てきてどのくらいですか？ご連絡はとっているのかしら？
dialogue.content: How long has it been since you moved out? Do you keep in touch?

dialogue.origin: もう10年くらい
dialogue.content: It's been about 10 years now.

dialogue.origin: 連絡はたまにだけ
dialogue.content: We only talk occasionally.

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: それは寂しいですね。
dialogue.content: That sounds lonely.

dialogue.origin: 寂しいというか、割り切ってるんで
dialogue.content: It's not so much that I'm lonely; it's more that I've come to terms with it.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね…。比べて腹立たしいという気持ちもあるんでしょうか？どんな気持ちですか？
dialogue.content: I see... Do you also feel resentful about being compared? What kind of feelings do you have?

dialogue.origin: そうですねー。腹立たしいのもあるし、反対に突き放して家族のことをあんまり考えないようにしてる感じですかね
dialogue.content: Let's see... There's some resentment, but on the other hand, I also feel like I push them away and try not to think about my family too much.

dialogue.origin: そっかぁ…そうなるのも無理はないと思います。。
dialogue.content: I see... I think it's completely understandable that you'd feel that way.

dialogue.origin: ここまでのお話をまとめさせていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Would it be alright if I summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたは飲食店で働いていたけれど、コロナの状況で給料が減り家賃が払えなくなり落ち込んでらっしゃいます。
dialogue.content: You were working at a restaurant, but due to the COVID situation, your salary decreased, you can no longer afford your rent, and you're feeling down as a result.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: なんとか頑張ろうと夜のレジも掛け持ちしたけれど今度は体調を崩してしまい、この先どうしようか不安になっています。今は週一二時間今の飲食店に勤めておられますね。
dialogue.content: You tried your best by taking on a second job as a night cashier, but then your health suffered, leaving you worried about what to do next. You are now working at your current restaurant for two hours, once a week.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 実家に帰るにも、妹と比べられる環境が嫌で帰れない…。ご実家には腹立たしさもあり、あんまり考えようにしているとのことです。
dialogue.content: And as for returning home, you can't, because you dislike the environment of being compared to your sister. You feel some resentment towards your family and are trying not to think about them too much.

dialogue.origin: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Does that sound about right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: あなたは高卒で関東に出てこられて、今まで一人でとてもよく頑張ってこられました。
dialogue.content: You came to the Kanto region right after high school, and you've worked incredibly hard all on your own until now.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: なかなかできる事ではないです。。10年間も…
dialogue.content: That’s not something just anyone can do... especially for ten years.

dialogue.origin: すごいことだと思います。
dialogue.content: I think that’s amazing.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ここからは私が思ったこととご提案なのですが、お伝えしてもいいですか？
dialogue.content: From this point, I have some thoughts and a suggestion. May I share them with you?

dialogue.origin: お願いします
dialogue.content: Please do.

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Okay,

dialogue.origin: あなたは、一人で10年間も頑張り、それでも今もなお頑張り続けようとしています。
dialogue.content: You’ve been working hard on your own for ten years, and even now, you’re still trying to keep pushing forward.

dialogue.origin: 困っていても、ご自分で何とかしようと…
dialogue.content: Even when you’re struggling, you try to handle things by yourself...

dialogue.origin: なんとかしないと生きていけないから…
dialogue.content: Because if I don't, I can't survive...

dialogue.origin: 自身の力で乗り越えようとするあなたは力強く、そして人に心配をかけまいとお優しい。。
dialogue.content: Your drive to overcome things on your own shows your strength, and your desire not to worry others shows your kindness.

dialogue.origin: 芯のある素晴らしい方だと思いました。
dialogue.content: I think you're a wonderful person with a strong core.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。そんなこと言われたことないので嬉しい
dialogue.content: Thank you. No one has ever said that to me before, so I'm happy to hear it.

dialogue.origin: はい、本当にそう思います。それとは反対に、ご実家で比べられていたから…なんとか親に結果を見せなければ…という気持ちも伝わってきましたがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Yes, I truly believe that. On the other hand, because you were always compared at home... I also get the sense that you feel you have to prove your success to your parents. Does that resonate with you?

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれませんが…どうだろう？？
dialogue.content: That might be true... I’m not sure.

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご実家にはご相談はしましたか？
dialogue.content: Have you discussed this with your family?

dialogue.origin: 一応相談しましたが、やっぱり地方には帰りたくないって気持ちが強いから
dialogue.content: I did, sort of, but my feeling of not wanting to go back home is just too strong.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: なんとか方法ありませんか？
dialogue.content: Isn't there some other way?

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お伝えしますね。
dialogue.content: Let me share my thoughts.

dialogue.origin: あなたは、親の評価などを気にして進めだせないのかなと思いました。【比べられる】ことがどこかで状況を足踏みさせているのかな、と感じましたが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I was thinking that perhaps you're unable to move forward because you're worried about your parents' evaluation of you. I sense that this experience of being 'compared' is holding you back somehow. What do you think about that?

dialogue.origin: (お時間過ぎても大丈夫ですか？)
dialogue.content: (Is it alright if we go a little over time?)

dialogue.origin: そうですね…比べられるのは本当に嫌です。すごく気にしています
dialogue.content: That's true... I really hate being compared. It bothers me a lot.

dialogue.origin: （少しだけなら
dialogue.content: (If it’s just for a little while.)

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうですよね。とても嫌なことだと思います。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right. It must be a very unpleasant feeling.

dialogue.origin: (ありがとうございます！終息に向かいます)
dialogue.content: (Thank you! I'll start wrapping up.)

dialogue.origin: 【評価】基準ではなく【自分】基準で選んでいくと、もしかしたら進みだせるかもしれません。その方法は
dialogue.content: If you start making choices based on 'your own' standards instead of others' 'evaluation' standards, you might be able to move forward. One way to do that is...

dialogue.origin: まずは自分を満たしてあげる事。
dialogue.content: First, to attend to your own needs.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お風呂に入ったり、アロマをかいだり、自分をリラックスさせることが有効です。
dialogue.content: Things like taking a bath or enjoying aromatherapy—anything that helps you relax can be effective.

dialogue.origin: でも、お金のことに困ってらっしゃるとのことなので
dialogue.content: However, since you mentioned you’re struggling financially...

dialogue.origin: ええ。余裕がありません
dialogue.content: Yes. I don't really have the luxury for that.

dialogue.origin: リラックスしたいけど
dialogue.content: I want to relax, but...

dialogue.origin: まずは【自分だけで頑張る】を少しだけ緩めて【人に頼る】事を取り入れていくといいと思います
dialogue.content: First, I think it would be good to loosen your grip on the idea of 'doing everything by yourself' and start incorporating 'relying on others'.

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 例えば行政、友達、家族…
dialogue.content: For example, government services, friends, family...

dialogue.origin: ここの窓口…
dialogue.content: This service here, as well...

dialogue.origin: 人に頼るのはいけないと思っていました
dialogue.content: I always thought it was wrong to rely on others.

dialogue.origin: 今日はあなたにとって一歩踏み出せた記念日ですね！
dialogue.content: Then today is a milestone for you—the day you took a step forward!

dialogue.origin: はい！ありがとうございます！
dialogue.content: Yes! Thank you!

dialogue.origin: 【人に頼る】を実行した記念ですね
dialogue.content: It marks the day you put 'relying on others' into practice.

dialogue.origin: 人は
dialogue.content: People,

dialogue.origin: 慣れないことをすると、とても疲れます。
dialogue.content: get very tired when they do something they're not used to.

dialogue.origin: ですので【人に頼る】を練習した日には先程お伝えした方法を日常に取り入れてみて下さいね！
dialogue.content: So, on the days you practice 'relying on others,' please try to incorporate the relaxation methods I mentioned earlier into your daily routine.

dialogue.origin: 今困っている方も沢山いるので、行政関係を調べたり、いろんなところに「頼る」やってみて下さいね。
dialogue.content: There are many people in difficult situations right now, so please try looking into government support and 'relying on' various resources.

dialogue.origin: もちろんここにも、またお越しいただければと思います！
dialogue.content: And of course, I hope you'll come back here again as well!

dialogue.origin: はい。ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: ええ、お優しいあなただから心配かけないように人のことを考えるのだと思います。ぜひご自分にも優しくしてあげてくださいね！
dialogue.content: Yes, I think it's because you are such a kind person that you always think of others and try not to worry them. Please be sure to be kind to yourself as well.

dialogue.origin: 本日は、お越しいただきありがとうございました。また、やってみてどうだったか教えてくださいね。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming today. Please let me know how it goes when you try these things.

dialogue.origin: はい。ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: (ありがとうございました！遅くなりごめんなさい…)
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much! I'm sorry for going over time...)

dialogue.origin: （いえいえ、こちらこそありがとうございました
dialogue.content: (No, not at all. Thank you as well.)

dialogue.origin: ええ、それでは終了いたしますね。
dialogue.content: Okay, then we'll end the session here.

dialogue.origin: (ありがとうございます！)
dialogue.content: (Thank you!)

dialogue.origin: (終了ボタン押します)
dialogue.content: (I'm pressing the end button now.)

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.
